risk: Supplier paid twice / invoice recorded twice
possible_cause: Manual keying, re-submitted invoice, no duplicate check
proposed_control: Duplicate-invoice check before payment; unique invoice reference; three-way match
evidence_needed: Invoice number, supplier, amount, payment record, bank statement
test_question: Are duplicate invoice numbers or identical amounts flagged before payment?
result_in_dataset: 2 exact duplicate pairs found (EUR 7,289.32); payment status unknown

possible_cause: Limit exceeded, emergency purchase, approval bypassed
proposed_control: Delegated approval matrix; PO required above threshold; system-enforced limits
evidence_needed: Purchase order, approval record, workflow log, invoice
test_question: Was approval obtained before the purchase, and by the right authority?
result_in_dataset: Not testable: no PO or approval field. Three unbudgeted lines (EUR 10,421.61) prompt the question but do not prove a bypass

possible_cause: Free-text categories, unclear taxonomy, manual coding
proposed_control: Defined category list; mandatory pick-list; periodic coding review
evidence_needed: Ledger description, coding policy, category master
test_question: Is the category consistent with the policy and the description?
result_in_dataset: Partly testable: 6 non-canonical labels corrected, 0 unmapped after mapping; 2 blank descriptions (EUR 19,040.17) cannot be coded

possible_cause: No budget line, mid-year initiative, budget moved elsewhere
proposed_control: Budget coverage check before commitment; supplementary budget process
test_question: Was a budget approved, and if not, who authorised the spend?
result_in_dataset: Testable: 3 unbudgeted lines, EUR 10,421.61 (TXN-2040, TXN-2248, TXN-2336)

possible_cause: Replacement coded as maintenance; no capitalisation review
proposed_control: Capitalisation policy; capex threshold; asset-register check
evidence_needed: Work order, asset register, capitalisation policy, approval
test_question: Is the chiller replacement capital or revenue, and who decided?
result_in_dataset: Not testable from the ledger alone: TXN-2326 (EUR 15,115.25) is the candidate

possible_cause: Spot rates, fuel surcharge, expedited mode, volume spike
proposed_control: Contracted rate card; shipment approval; monthly freight review
evidence_needed: Carrier contract, rate card, shipment log, invoice
test_question: Was the invoiced rate consistent with the contract, and was expedited mode approved?
result_in_dataset: Testable at total level: freight +EUR 30,829 (+16.7%); June +44.6%; one line +EUR 15,077

possible_cause: Credit received without original invoice; prior-period credit
proposed_control: Credit-note matching; supplier statement reconciliation; period allocation rule
evidence_needed: Credit note, original invoice, supplier statement, accrual schedule
test_question: Is each credit matched to an original invoice and allocated to the right period?
result_in_dataset: Not testable: 4 credit notes (EUR 5,293.69) but no invoice reference field

possible_cause: Late posting, accrual missed, manual journal
proposed_control: Close checklist; date validation; accrual and prepayment review
evidence_needed: Ledger date, GRN date, accrual schedule, close checklist
test_question: Are there transactions dated outside the period, and were they accrued in the right month?

possible_cause: Manual uploads, free-text fields, no validation
proposed_control: Upload validation rules; mandatory fields; DQ exception review
evidence_needed: DQ log, upload specification, review sign-off
test_question: Are exceptions identified, reviewed and resolved before reporting?
result_in_dataset: Testable: 37 unique flagged rows (7 corrected, 18 flagged, 10 quarantined, 2 out-of-period)
